name: Barbell Squat
description: 1. Place barbell on shoulders behind neck. 2. Squat down keeping back straight. 3. Push up to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: 1. Lie on bench with dumbbells in hand. 2. Lower dumbbells to chest. 3. Press up until arms extended.

name: Barbell Deadlift
description: 1. Stand with feet hip-width apart. 2. Grip barbell and lift with straight back. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: 1. Sit and hold cable handles. 2. Pull handles towards abdomen. 3. Slowly release.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: 1. Sit at lat pulldown machine. 2. Pull bar down to chest. 3. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: 1. Sit upright holding dumbbells. 2. Press above head. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Leg Press
description: 1. Sit on leg press machine. 2. Push platform with feet. 3. Slowly return.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
description: 1. Stand facing cable. 2. Push bar down until arms extended. 3. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: 1. Hold dumbbells with arms down. 2. Curl up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: 1. Position bar on shoulders. 2. Squat down. 3. Push back up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: 1. Lie on incline bench. 2. Press dumbbells up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Leg Extension
description: 1. Sit on machine. 2. Extend legs fully. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Leg Curl Machine
description: 1. Lie or sit depending on machine. 2. Curl legs. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Chest Fly Machine
description: 1. Sit and grab handles. 2. Bring arms together in front. 3. Return slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: 1. Stand by cable. 2. Raise arm to side. 3. Lower slowly.

name: T-Bar Row
description: 1. Hold T-bar. 2. Row towards chest. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
description: 1. Sit with back against bench. 2. Thrust hips up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
description: 1. Kneel at cable machine. 2. Crunch down. 3. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
description: 1. Hold dumbbells. 2. Step forward and lower. 3. Push back.

name: Cable Face Pull
description: 1. Grab rope at cable. 2. Pull towards face. 3. Release slowly.

name: Chest Press Machine
description: 1. Sit and hold handles. 2. Push forward. 3. Return slowly.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
description: 1. Sit at preacher bench. 2. Curl bar/dumbbell. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Back Extension Machine
description: 1. Lie face down. 2. Lift torso. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Press Machine
description: 1. Sit and place feet. 2. Push platform. 3. Return slowly.

name: Cable Upright Row
description: 1. Hold rope/bar. 2. Pull to chin. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Decline Bench Press
description: 1. Lie on decline bench. 2. Press barbell up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: 1. Sit, hold dumbbell. 2. Extend arms overhead. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: 1. Sit at machine. 2. Press handles up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: 1. Hold handles. 2. Open arms to sides. 3. Return slowly.

name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
description: 1. Sit and place balls of feet. 2. Lift heels. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
description: 1. Sit on bench with back support and hold dumbbells. 2. Rotate palms outward while pressing up. 3. Lower slowly back down.

name: Incline Barbell Press
description: 1. Lie on an incline bench (30-45°). 2. Lower bar to chest, then press up.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: 1. Lie on a flat bench. 2. Open arms wide with dumbbells, then bring them together over chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: 1. Lie on an incline bench. 2. Open arms wide with dumbbells, then bring them together over chest.

name: Cable Chest Press
description: 1. Stand between cable columns holding handles. 2. Press forward and slowly return.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: 1. Place shoulders on bench with barbell over hips. 2. Thrust hips upward, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Step-up
description: 1. Hold dumbbells, step onto a bench or platform. 2. Step down, alternate legs.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
description: 1. Hold rope overhead. 2. Extend arms fully, then slowly return.

name: Standing Barbell Curl
description: 1. Hold barbell with arms straight. 2. Curl towards shoulders, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
description: 1. Hold dumbbells with neutral grip. 2. Curl up to shoulders, lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: 1. Lie on incline bench, arms down. 2. Curl dumbbells up, lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: 1. Sit on machine with pad on lower legs. 2. Curl legs towards glutes, lower slowly.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: 1. Stand on edge, lift heels up, lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
description: 1. Lie on flat bench with Smith bar. 2. Lower to chest, press up.

name: Incline Smith Machine Press
description: 1. Lie on incline bench with Smith bar. 2. Press up, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: 1. Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. 2. Raise straight up to shoulder height, lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: 1. Stand by cable column, hold handle. 2. Raise to side to shoulder level, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: 1. Hold dumbbells. 2. Shrug shoulders up and down slowly.

name: Chest Dips
description: 1. Grab dip bars. 2. Lower body slowly, push back up.

name: Lat Pullover Machine
description: 1. Sit on machine, hold handles. 2. Pull weight from behind head to front slowly.

name: Push-up
description: 1. Place hands shoulder-width apart. 2. Lower body until chest nearly touches ground. 3. Push back up.

name: Pull-up
description: 1. Grab bar with palms facing away. 2. Pull body up until chin above bar. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: 1. Stand feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Squat down keeping chest up. 3. Push through heels to stand.

name: Lunge
description: 1. Step forward with one leg. 2. Lower hips until both knees are bent 90°. 3. Push back to start.

name: Plank
description: 1. Support body on elbows and toes. 2. Keep body straight. 3. Hold position.

name: Mountain Climber
description: 1. Start in plank. 2. Alternate bringing knees to chest quickly. 3. Keep core tight.

name: Burpee
description: 1. Squat, place hands on floor. 2. Jump feet back into plank. 3. Jump forward and up.

name: Tricep Dip
description: 1. Place hands on bench. 2. Lower body by bending elbows. 3. Push back up.

name: Glute Bridge
description: 1. Lie on back, knees bent. 2. Lift hips until body forms straight line. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Side Plank
description: 1. Lie on side, support on elbow. 2. Lift hips, keep body straight. 3. Hold.

name: High Knees
description: 1. Run in place, lifting knees to chest. 2. Pump arms. 3. Maintain speed.

name: Jumping Jack
description: 1. Jump with legs apart, arms overhead. 2. Return to start. 3. Repeat.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: 1. Step backward, lower into lunge. 2. Push back to start. 3. Alternate legs.

name: Diamond Push-up
description: 1. Hands together forming diamond. 2. Lower chest to hands. 3. Push back up.

name: Leg Raise
description: 1. Lie on back, legs straight. 2. Lift legs until vertical. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: 1. Lie on back, hands behind head. 2. Alternate elbow to opposite knee. 3. Repeat.

name: Side Lunge
description: 1. Step to side, bend knee, push hips back. 2. Return to start. 3. Alternate sides.

name: Inchworm
description: 1. Stand, bend forward, walk hands to plank. 2. Walk feet forward. 3. Repeat.

name: Wall Sit
description: 1. Lean back against wall. 2. Slide down until knees 90°. 3. Hold.

name: Superman
description: 1. Lie face down. 2. Lift arms and legs off floor. 3. Hold and lower slowly.

name: Pike Push-up
description: 1. Form inverted V. 2. Bend elbows, lower head. 3. Push back up.

name: Flutter Kick
description: 1. Lie on back, lift legs slightly. 2. Alternate kicking up and down. 3. Keep core tight.

name: Skater Jump
description: 1. Leap sideways to land on one foot. 2. Swing other leg behind. 3. Alternate sides.

name: Clapping Push-up
description: 1. Perform push-up, push explosively. 2. Clap hands mid-air. 3. Land softly and repeat.

name: Reverse Plank
description: 1. Sit, hands behind. 2. Lift hips to form straight line. 3. Hold.

name: Step-up (onto chair)
description: 1. Step onto chair with one foot. 2. Push through heel. 3. Step down, alternate.

name: Wall Handstand Hold
description: 1. Kick into handstand against wall. 2. Hold position. 3. Lower carefully.

name: Crab Walk
description: 1. Sit, lift hips. 2. Walk forward/backward on hands and feet. 3. Keep core tight.

name: Donkey Kick
description: 1. Start on all fours. 2. Kick leg back and up. 3. Lower slowly. Alternate.

name: Bear Crawl
description: 1. Crawl on hands and feet forward/backward. 2. Keep low and core tight.

name: Side Leg Raise
description: 1. Lie on side. 2. Lift top leg up. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: 1. Lie on back. 2. Lift hips towards chest. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Spiderman Push-up
description: 1. Perform push-up, bring knee to elbow. 2. Return and repeat other side.

name: Jump Squat
description: 1. Squat down. 2. Jump explosively up. 3. Land softly, repeat.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
description: 1. Hold side plank. 2. Lower hips towards floor. 3. Lift back up.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
description: 1. Lie on back, one foot on floor. 2. Lift hips. 3. Lower slowly, alternate.

name: Donkey Kick to Pulse
description: 1. On all fours, kick leg up. 2. Pulse at top. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: 1. Lie on back. 2. Lift arms/legs, hold. 3. Keep core tight.

name: Wall Push-up
description: 1. Place hands on wall. 2. Lower chest to wall. 3. Push back.

name: Standing Side Crunch
description: 1. Stand. 2. Bend torso sideways, elbow towards hip. 3. Return slowly.

name: Leg Circles
description: 1. Lie on back. 2. Lift leg, draw circles. 3. Repeat other leg.

name: Wall Handstand Push-up
description: 1. Kick into handstand. 2. Bend elbows to lower head. 3. Push back up.

name: Inverted Row
description: 1. Lie under bar. 2. Pull chest to bar. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Step Lunge
description: 1. Step forward, bend knee, lower hips. 2. Push back. 3. Alternate.

name: Side Step Squat
description: 1. Step sideways, squat down. 2. Return. 3. Alternate.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
description: 1. Lie face down. 2. Lift arms and legs, move like snow angel. 3. Lower slowly.

name: Scissor Kicks
description: 1. Lie on back. 2. Alternate legs up and down. 3. Keep core tight.

name: Spider Crawl
description: 1. Crawl forward/back with opposite hand and foot. 2. Keep low. 3. Repeat.

name: Hip Circles
description: 1. On all fours, move hips in circle. 2. Reverse direction. 3. Repeat.

name: Bird Dog
description: 1. On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg. 2. Hold, return. 3. Alternate.
